system.description:
Choose one of the following effects: [Check: Opposed (Accuracy vs Resistance) / Effect: Remove [SR] number of Combat Statuses from the target (your choice).] or [Check: Basic (Accuracy vs. Disable Difficulty) / Effect: Remove one Prop with the [Magical] tag.]

(SR2): This skill changes to [Range: 4 Sq.]
(SR3): This skill may be used with [Timing: Instant].

A magic that analyzes the flow of magical power, etc., and strikes against it with contradictory magical power to negate its effects.
